explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 68 configurations over 7 sweeps (topology-ep, engine-cudagraph, kv-precision, admission-batched-tokens, admission-prefill-chunking, drafting, routing-and-prefix-cache), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 32 GPUs.
4x TP8 + EP (5 draft tokens), from the drafting sweep, reached 32.04 tok/s/GPU (1025.3 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 64 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
4x TP8 + EP (5 draft tokens) at concurrency 64. 214 of 272 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per GPU, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: EP on should win at tp 8 (sharding 128 experts frees KV room) while the all-to-all starts eating the gain at tp 4.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 at 30.78 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: topology-ep

prose: FULL and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE should edge out the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (graph capture full+piecewise · max captured step 512) at 31.31 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: engine-cudagraph

prose: Halving KV bytes per entry should cache far more tokens per GPU, which on a prefix-heavy replay converts straight into throughput.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (KV dtype nvfp4_ds_mla) at 30.93 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: kv-precision

prose: Throughput should rise with the cap and flatten above 16384, leaving the 8192 default short of optimal on this traffic.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at 31.9 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: admission-batched-tokens

prose: Chunking should HURT throughput here, so the uncapped default wins and this sweep prices the interactivity it would buy.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP (prefill chunk 4,096) at 31.15 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: admission-prefill-chunking

prose: dspark drafting should pay on this decode-bound replay, with the gain growing toward the graph's declared num_spec_tokens of 5.
Measured: best was 4x TP8 + EP (5 draft tokens) at 32.04 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: drafting

prose: prefix-affinity with caching on should win and random with caching off should be the floor; the gap is the value of prefix reuse.
Measured: best was 8x TP4 + EP (prefix-affinity routing) at 30.83 tok/s/GPU (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: routing-and-prefix-cache
